zinou.title: From ZINOU butcher to your plate
zinou.badge: 100% of our meat comes from ZINOU butcher
zinou.text: At Sushi Smile, our meat never comes from industrial suppliers. We source it directly from ZINOU, our trusted local butcher. The result: fresh, fully traceable meat prepared on site — for dishes you can enjoy with complete peace of mind.
zinou.feat1Text: Picked from the butcher every day, never prepared in advance.
zinou.feat2Text: From the butcher straight to your plate, no industrial middleman.
zinou.feat3Text: The same high standard with every order, in every season.
zinou.feat4Text: Rigorously selected products, cooked in our own kitchen.
zinou.products: saté chicken, the chicken in our bowls, beef & cheese skewers and every meat-based dish we make.
zinou.imageAlt: Grilled glazed meat skewers prepared at Sushi Smile

restaurant.title: The restaurant
restaurant.pageTitle: Homemade Japanese cuisine, in the heart of Vienne
restaurant.story: Sushi Smile is a genuine Japanese restaurant, based in Vienne since 2018. Every maki, every California roll and every specialty is rolled and plated by hand, on site, from fresh ingredients selected daily. We welcome you at the counter like family — to enjoy in or take away. Push the door open: come taste the difference of homemade.
restaurant.ctaTitle: Hungry? Order in just a few clicks.
restaurant.ctaText: Pickup at the restaurant, pay on site or online.

highlights.point1Text: Find our whole menu on the site: makis, California rolls, poke bowls, chirashis, specialties… at the same price as in the restaurant, with no commission. You order online and pick up your fresh order at the counter, ready at your chosen time. Pay on site or online, whichever you prefer.
highlights.point2Text: At Sushi Smile, quality is at the heart of everything. Our sushi is rolled and plated on site, every day, from carefully selected fresh ingredients. Strict hygiene and craftsmanship at every step, so every bite lives up to your expectations.
highlights.point3Text: A regular since 2018? We thank you the way you deserve. With our loyalty card, every order brings you closer to tasty rewards. Ask for your card at the counter and enjoy it on every visit to Sushi Smile.
